eta.note: ETA divides remaining DCS-attested verb roots by the mean roots promoted per active day (from store provenance timestamps of already-promoted roots) — rate unit is roots/day, matching the remaining-roots numerator; still an estimate.

nominal.note: Nominal burn-down: remaining runnable candidates divided by the mean keys promoted per active day (store provenance timestamps of already-promoted keys). collision_guard.operator_one_liner: If the kitchen collision banner is red (or collision_guard.blocked=true): DO NOT start a second paid window on those keys/root — a live job or recent store-hit / lease collision already holds them. Wait for the live job to finish or requeue that lease; only then import another window.
